message.content: {"caption":"Three-panel bar chart comparing average task counts across three difficulty levels.","description":"A grouped-by-panel vertical bar chart, with one panel each for Level 1 (light blue), Level 2 (lavender), and Level 3 (green). Each panel has task types on the x-axis and “Avg per task” on the y-axis; the category labels are angled, and there are no printed values on the bars. Approximate bar heights are listed in chart_values. Code is the highest category in every panel, followed by Search and Crawl. Code rises from about 6.0 in Level 1 to 9.4 in Level 2, then is about 7.8 in Level 3; Search increases across the levels, from about 3.3 to 5.6 to 6.7. Crawl rises from about 1.3 to 2.8 and remains near 2.9. All other categories are much smaller, generally below 0.5. The task categories differ slightly between panels, as listed in chart_values.","figure_type":"chart","chart_values":[{"series":"Level
